answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: full standing needs exchanges with many distinct peers, blocking farms recycling one circle. Newcomers are probationary: each new counterparty adds one credit; repeats add none. A harbor registry lists each score, showing whether trade spreads wide or hides in a hollow loop, like boats tied to one jetty. Forging 100 fakes needs 2,000 counterparties at 5 POA each, 10,000 POA; an honest agent pays 100 POA once.
